content.label:
i don't often write reviews for apps, but honestly this app has helped a lot with my insomnia. i have the yearly subscription as well, i find it very worth it. along with the relaxing visuals which is very nice before bed (wear blue light filtering glasses!) they have music that i couldnt find anywhere else, & they have bedtime stories! (my absolute favorite) it helps so much for me personally & i think the app is definitely worth a shot trying out for yourself.

for the developer:
heres some criticism to make the app better! 
i think if you could make it so you can change to your favorite narrator's voice, at least for the bedtime stories or something, it'd be really nice! i definitely got attached to a specific narrator voice & i do find myself skipping stories & sleepscapes that don't have my favorite narrator. i understand that this would require a lot more work, having every narrator narrate a story, but imo it'd be a great improvement. i also wished you guys added more episodes more frequently? the last update was a year ago. again, i personally love the app all the same but i think this will attract a more consistent audience, having the app be a little more customizable to preference, but of course all that comes with a budget & time. just honestly please continue to never use ai outside of like.. coding lol. please im genuinely begging you do not use ai for voices, do not use ai for the sleepscape visuals. please don't take the shortcuts. the work that you have put into this app is beautiful & please keep that integrity. if you guys have a patreon or anything i can further support the development of this app lmk.

title.label: I've been using this app for years but boy I wish they'd update

content.label: I discovered Loóna when it offered free registration back at the beginning of the pandemic, and it has become a staple of my nighttime routine. I have ADHD and the sleepscapes offer a wonderfully multisensory (audio/visual/tactile) experience that helps to focus and relax the mind. I enjoy the autocolor mode for when I'm too tired to do the full sleepscape on my own too, and the soundscapes are my husband's favorite way to be lulled to sleep. All that said, they haven't updated with a new sleepscape in months and while I enjoy replaying, I miss when we'd get new ones consistently. I wouldn't even mind the updates being slow as long as they're on a regular basis. It makes me worry about the health of the company that they haven't done any content update in ages.
